name: beat_bar_v1
description: What a beat (and a miss) has paid on past prints set up like each coming reporter. Positioning cell = terciles of the recipe's grid axes on the lab's prints (run-up into the print, the three-month tape, the three-month EPS estimate change); inside the cell the prints are split by outcome (EPS beat / miss, B/B and B/M mix) and measured on the reaction vs the market and the hold-through from the pre-print close. The bar is the lowest EPS-surprise quintile whose reaction mean is positive in the cell. Pointer cells repeat the beat / miss split on one pre-print field's quintile at a time. Zero cutoffs beyond the floors; no ranking, no course.
measures: Hold from the pre-print close, 7 days, excess (pp)
Hold from the pre-print close, 28 days, excess (pp)
